Title: Israel's Coast Restored by Jonah's Word
Promise: Israel's territory would be restored from the Hamath frontier to the lowland sea, as the LORD had spoken through Jonah. Doubt: Promise content is reported, not quoted: the text says Jeroboam restored the coast 'according to the word of the LORD... by Jonah' without quoting the word itself, so the promise wording cannot be verified from this book.
Fulfillment: The restoration itself is recorded in the same verse.
